raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner confused the transmission language (Old French) with the actual language of origin. Despite multiple sources confirming that Sylvester derives from Latin (silvestris) — which, in the 800 A.D. Carolingian context, is Medieval Latin — the Planner wrongly asserted that the “relevant origin” should be Old French for that era. This misinterpretation of “origin” versus vernacular transmission led to the incorrect solution.
